summary.en-US: Search 9,600+ independent shops on the ZUREQ network, watch prices and get ready-to-pay cart links.

description.en-US:
ZUREQ Shopper gives you one focused shopping workspace for product discovery, shopping lists, price alerts, and checkout links across 9,600+ independent shops in the US, Poland, and Austria. Connect with your ZUREQ account or use your own API key to access the ZUREQ MCP API.

Featured integration on zureq.io (https://zureq.io).

HOW IT WORKS

1. Connect with ZUREQ in Options (Google works), or add your API key.
2. Search for a product in the Firefox sidebar.
3. Search a list of up to 10 items, or click the button on a supported shop product page.
4. Review products, variants, prices, and checkout links before choosing where to buy.
5. Watch a product or search and get notified when it gets cheaper, reaches your target price, or is back in stock.

FEATURES

Product search with country, price, stock, result-limit filters, image placeholders, product details, and variants.

Busy buttons and spinners show progress during longer actions; Search also displays skeleton results while loading.

List searches up to 10 items with up to five candidates per item and per-shop totals.

Shop-aware checkout checks support and respects each shop's cart line limit, splitting carts into separate links when needed.

Price alerts for watched products and searches: an optional target price, back-in-stock alerts for products, a local price history with the lowest price in 30 days, and a configurable background check interval.

Find on ZUREQ network button on supported shop product pages, including market-matched searches and an optional same-currency cheaper-result marker.

A header usage badge shows remaining credits and this session's estimated spend; context-menu actions, recent searches, and list state are also available.

CREDITS

Connect with your ZUREQ account or use your own API key. Tool calls use the following credits:

search_products: 3 credits (1 if nothing is found)
get_product: 1 credit
create_checkout_link: 1 credit
get_shop: 1 credit (cached per shop for 24 hours)
list_shops, list_categories: 1 credit each
list_markets and get_usage: free

Each List search costs up to 3 credits per item. Checkout links use 1 credit per request and respect each shop's line limit. The extension checks shop support with get_shop before creating links; shop metadata is cached for 24 hours.

PRIVACY

API keys are stored in browser sync storage; OAuth sign-in tokens stay only in this browser's local storage. MCP requests go to api.zureq.io; chat.zureq.io is contacted only for sign-in, token refresh, and disconnect. Search history, list state, and market cache stay in local browser extension storage. Supported shop pages are read only after you click the extension button. There is no tracking, analytics, or data selling.

REQUIREMENTS

Firefox 142 or later on desktop. Connect with a ZUREQ account or use a ZUREQ API key.

SINGLE PURPOSE

ZUREQ Shopper helps people discover products, build shopping lists, and watch prices across the ZUREQ network.

version.approval_notes: This extension uses no compilation or minification. The Firefox package copies the files in scripts/files.txt as-is; scripts/build-firefox.js only adapts the manifest for Firefox. Source: https://github.com/dzienisz/zureq-shopper. Testing requires the user's own ZUREQ account or API key; no test key is provided. Without either, the Firefox sidebar shows the Connect your ZUREQ account state. MCP requests go to api.zureq.io; chat.zureq.io is contacted only for sign-in, token refresh, and disconnect.
